description: This file defines the custom exception class 'UnknownTopicPathException' used within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter to signal unsupported topic paths. It includes nested builder class for constructing instances and static methods for creating exceptions from messages or JSON objects.

classes.name: UnknownTopicPathException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating an unsupported protocol topic path, extending DittoRuntimeException.

classes.name: UnknownTopicPathException.Builder
classes.description: Fluent builder for constructing instances of UnknownTopicPathException.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for UnknownTopicPathException given a TopicPath or String.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an UnknownTopicPathException from a message string and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an UnknownTopicPathException from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers.

methods.name: fromTopicAndPath
methods.description: Creates an exception for unsupported combination of topic path and message path.
